provenance.sequence_source: p15A origin; bases V00309 218-763 (Selzer et al. 1983), reverse complement, identical over this span; = pACYC184 (X06403) 848-1393 except the base at V00309 662, which the deposit itself flags as a conflict. Re-delimited (2026-11) from 562 bp (V00309 206-767): the old part also carried 12 bp upstream of the RNA II -35 and 4 bp past the RNA-to-DNA transition (V00309 764-767, which include the DNA start nucleotides).

functional_claims.label: Medium-copy ColE1-type (p15A) origin; copy number set by the RNA I/RNA II antisense system.

source.quote: The p15A origin: the 546 bp natural ColE1-type replication origin from the RNA II promoter -35 to the RNA-to-DNA transition, whose copy number is controlled by the divergent RNA I / RNA II antisense system.

functional_claims.label: Spans p15A V00309 218-763 (minus strand): from the RNA II promoter -35 (TTGAGA, the ColE1 -35 conserved) to the RNA-to-DNA transition. Selzer et al. map the replication start to three consecutive nucleotides, deposited as V00309 rep_origin 764..766; the part ends at the base before them, the ColE1 part's end by alignment (pBR322 2534). This is the 546 bp span conventionally annotated as "p15A ori".

source.quote: In each system, replication initiates at any of three consecutive nucleotides located at a unique site. Primer transcription starts 508 bp upstream of the replication origin.
